name: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite
description: KITTI Vision Benchmark Suite is a widely used benchmark for autonomous driving perception tasks, including stereo vision, optical flow, visual odometry, object detection, and 3D scene understanding from road-driving imagery.
evaluation_method: Task-specific metrics such as Average Precision (AP) for detection, end-point error for optical flow, odometry trajectory error, and disparity/depth error for stereo tasks.
typical_sota_score: Varies by subtask; modern models are often near-saturated on 2D detection but remain challenging on 3D perception and odometry.
notes: This is a multi-task benchmark suite rather than a single metric dataset. It has been foundational for autonomous driving research and early 3D perception systems.
